name: Hakari Course
description: Hakari Course is a calm, responsive WordPress theme designed for online food-safety supervisor courses powered by Tutor LMS and WooCommerce. It combines high-key kitchen photography, tilted card motifs, and clear tabular cohort pricing into a structured six-week course presentation. Built for culinary academies, it provides shift leads and kitchen supervisors with a focused, distraction-free learning experience.
deviation: Reference e-chubu.jp: full-bleed photo hero with 88px rounded bottom corners and a hashtag foot band crossing its edge, white 88px panels on a pastel wash, tilted rounded photo rows with big numbers, fixed vertical edge tabs, load zoom and bounce motion.
